<subject>Fw: Reclassification of Interest Income</subject>
<body>
FYI - If this request is approved, the reclassification of accrued interest income within Other Income-Other should increase pre-tax profit by approximately £560K for 2024 (Credit Risk £400K, Treasury £160K).
</body>
<quoted>
 -----Original Message-----
From: 	Evans, Josh  
Sent:	Thursday, 19 September 2024 10:43
To:	Marsh, Donald
Subject:	FW: Reclassification of Interest Income


fyi
 -----Original Message-----
From: 	Evans, Josh  
Sent:	Thursday, 19 September 2024 10:40
To:	Perkins, Jonathan; Robertson, Gemma
Cc:	Walters Jr., Paul; Smith, Ryan; Marshall, Robert; Carey, Howard; Graham, Amanda; Johnson, Valerie; Hughes, Dylan; Walters, Russell; Coleman, Maurice
Subject:	Reclassification of Interest Income


Request to reclassify the below two ledger codes for accrued interest income from ledger 1755 (Other Corporate Income)
to ledger 1690 (Other Income - Other)               Effective: for SEPTEMBER 2024 Close.

     Ledger Codes      Description                             From: Current Mapping              To: New Mapping
          78892830     Accrued Interest Settlement            1755_78892830                     1690_78892830
          60765877     Accrued Interest                        1755_60765877                     1690_60765877


 




Accrued interest income (ledger codes 78892830-Accrued Interest Settlement and 60765877-Accrued Interest) currently map to Corporate Lending ledger 1755-interest capitalised. The only business units using these two ledger codes as of August and the YTD credit balances in each are units 141-£425,320, 179-£262,480, 413-£10,150 (debit), 536-£2,450,100, 60-£72,850 and 62-£231,650.

In conclusion I have reviewed the proposed reclassification with representatives of the various Treasury business units and they confirmed the change would not create any issues for them.

PS.   Please notify me or Maurice Coleman when the change is made in Leeds so he can update the same ledger codes in the Regional Finance system. 
</quoted>
